title: Stop the loop before `items.length`.
comment:
**Stop the loop before `items.length`.**

The loop reaches `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`. Reading `.quantity` then throws. This also fails for an empty array.

Change `<=` to `<`. Empty arrays will return `0`, and nonempty arrays will visit only valid elements.

title: Await `save` in `removeItem` so the removal completes only after persistence.
comment:
**Await `save` in `removeItem` so the removal completes only after persistence.**

`removeItem` calls `save(path, next)` without `await`. `save` returns a `Promise<void>`, so this call discards the only completion signal for the write. `removeItem` can resolve before the write settles. A save failure then becomes an unhandled rejection and does not reach the caller. A caller that reads the file after `await removeItem(...)` can see the old contents.

Await the call so `removeItem` settles only after `save` settles:
